tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// nor bu bstan pa spyi dbang bya thabs chos spyod bcu nyams su len tshul dang bcas pa bstan pa'i tshal 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// gang gi drin gyis sku gsum rin chen gling*// snang mdzad srid mtsho sgrol ba'i gru 'dzin mchog /thugs rje'i rlung dar skyod mkhas bla ma rje// mchog gsum dbyer med zhabs la spyi bos 'dud// rgyal bstan lung rtogs zung 'jug gi /ngo mtshar rnyed dka'i dga' ston la// ci dgar 'phrul ba'i dbang byed po// nor bu bstan pa spyi dbang brjod// de yang yid du 'thad pa'i gnas su gnas khang byi dor chag chag gdab cing*/ dkon mchog gi rten bkram pa'i mdun du/ stegs kyi khar tshon nam 'bras kyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad bkod/ de'i lte bar mañdzi'i khar bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po'i sku rab gnas dang ldan pa bsham zhing*/ de'i mdun nam g.yas lta bu gang 'os su/ bka' bstan bcos kyi glegs bam yang bsham/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ slob ma mdun du 'khod la ci 'byor pa'i yon phul/ lag tu me tog gtad de maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad du/ 'dir jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti sha'i thugs sras 'brom ston pa chen po nas bka' gdams rin po che zhes grags pa las ston pa chen po'i thugs sras dge bshes sku mched gsum nas gzhung gdams ngag gnyis su byung ba las gzhung pa'i srol 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen pu to ba chen po de'i slob ma nyi ma lta bu zhang sha ra ba yon tan grags/ de'i slob ma byin rlabs kyi bka' babs gtum ston blo gros grags/ de'i thugs sras 'phags pa'i gnas brtan gyi rnam 'phrul du grags pa dpal ldan gro mo che bdud rtsi grags ces bya ba de la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan yan lag 'byung gis dngos su gnang ba'i nor bu bstan pa spyi dbang zhes bya ba 'di nod pa la brten/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis chos spyod rin po che rnam pa bcu'i bdag nyid kyi bka' bstan bcos thams cad la thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa la dbang ba'i rjes su gnang ba thob par 'gyur ba yin pas/

'di nyid kyi phyag bzhes dpal ldan gro mo che'i slob ma snar thang sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs de'i thugs sras dge ba'i bshes gnyen snar thang pa mchims chen po nam mkha' grags kyis mdzad pa ji lta ba bzhin du sgrub par byed pa la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i ched du/ nor bu bstan pa spyi dbang zhu snyam pas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces brda sbyar nas/ khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni// gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis// 'gro ba'i mgon po thub chen gyis// blo mchog ting 'dzin rnyed par mdzod// brtse ldan khyod kyi mkhyen rab 'od zer gyis// bdag blo'i gti mug mun pa rab bsal nas// bka' dang bstan bcos gzhung lugs rtogs pa yi// blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba stsal du gsol// sh+lo ka gcig lan gsum brjod/ mdun gyi nam mkha' 'di na rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i pad+mo yangs shing rgya che ba tshad med pa bkod pa'i steng du/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa bzhugs par mos te/ de'i drung du yan lag bdun pa rgyas par 'bul snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ spro na/ ji snyed su dag sogs dang*/ bsdu na/ sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing*// mchod sprin rgya mtshos rab tu mchod// sdig kun so sor bshags par bgyi// dge tshogs rnams la yi rang zhing*// chos 'khor rgya chen bskor du gsol// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog /ces lan gsum/ de nas bla ma dang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya'i rgyal po la rang gi lus rdul gyi grangs snyed du sprul zhing lce de snyed dang ldan pas dbyangs kyi yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgra skad kyis rgyal ba'i yon tan mkha' ltar mtha' yas shing tshad bzung du med pa la bsngags pa'i bstod pa brjod par mos pas rjes zlos/

gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// ces dang*/ thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs// gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung bcom nas// gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku// shākya'i rgyal po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sh+lo ka gcig brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis bla ma bcom ldan 'das shākya'i dbang po dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dung dung pa byas nas/ bla ma yang skad cig gis/ seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba bkod pa'i khyad par tshad ma mchis pas mngon par 'phags pa'i steng du lha rdzas kyi gos pañtsa li ka rin thang med pa du mas legs par bkab pa'i dbus su/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i smon lam gyi stobs las byung ba'i pad+ma chen po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa ka tsa li kā ltar reg na bde ba kha dog bzang po ltar mi bzod pa'i gzi 'od dang ldan pa tha gru tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i lte bar/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba dri ma med pa'i 'od dkar po 'phro ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ mum̐ yig gser gyi kha dog can 'od mtha' yas pa 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od las lhag pa'i 'od 'dom gang ba dang*/ 'od zer mtha' yas par mnga' ba/ sku la ngur smrig gi na bza' chos gos gsum mnabs shing*/ phyag g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbu'i gtsug tor ltar mi mngon pa dang phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan pa sogs mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ phyag zhabs kyi sor mo zangs mdog snum zhing phyag sor zlum rgyas ring ba drwa bas 'brel pa sogs dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/

sku mdzes shing lta bas chog mi shes pa mthong na mi mthun pa med pa/ dad pas mos pa rnams la mngon par dga' ba skyed pa de lta bu'i skur krong gis gyur par bsgom/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du chos kyi 'khor lo kha dog dkar po rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar mum̐ yig ser po'i mtha' skor du/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng gser gyi mdog lta bus bskor bar gsal thob la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang*// nyan dang klog dang len pa dang*// 'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang*// de sems pa dang sgom pa yi// dbang bskur dam pa bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po'i sku rab gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa 'di ngo bo nyid kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das nyid mngon sum bzhugs pa dang khyad med cing*/ khyed rang rnams kyi yid kyis kyang de ltar bzhugs pa yin snyam pa'i mos 'dun dung par byas pas/ gang gi sangs rgyas yid byed pa// de yi mdun na thub pa bzhugs// bya ba'i don can du 'ong ba yin// de'i thugs kar yang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sa bon sngags phreng sogs slob dpon gyi thugs kar bsgoms pa bzhin du 'od kor re yod par sgoms/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las/ mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung du bstan// tshigs bcad ched brjod gleng gzhi dang*// rtogs brjod de lta bu byung dang*// skyes rabs shin tu rgyas pa'i sde// rmad byung gtan la dbab pa'i sde// zhes pa'i gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis dang*/ chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi ngo bor gyur pa'i 'od zer gser btso ma'i kha dog lta bu dpag tu med pa dang ā li kā li dbyangs gsal gyi yig 'bru kha dog de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa 'phros pa rnams/

slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa drug nye ba'i nyon mongs pa nyi shu/ gzung 'dzin rnam rtog gi 'ching ba la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ shes byas bsdus pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag khyad par du'ang lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyud la skye ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs chen po bzhi dang*/ mi shes pa'i rgyu bzhi dang*/ ma rig pa gnyis dang*/ rmongs pa'i dri ma thams cad gzhom nas sgo gsum shel gyi gong bu ltar rnam par dag par gyur snyam pa'i mos pa gyis/ byas la thub pa'i sku spyi bor bzhag la/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang*// nyan dang klog dang len pa dang*// 'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang*// de sems pa dang sgom pa yi// dbang bskur dam pa khyod la sbyin// ces brjod pa'i rjes su me tog gtor zhing*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ye swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de ltar byas pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po'i sku/ sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig gnyis g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ sku la na bza' chos gos gsum mnabs shing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'od dang 'od zer 'phro ba'i skur gyur/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngag gsung rab yan lag gcu gnyis dang chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi ngo bor gyur/ khyed rang rnams kyi yid mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes can shes bya thams cad la chags thogs dang bral ba'i blo gros phun sum tshogs par gyur snyam pa'i nges shes brtan po sgoms/ de nas yang maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa de 'dra ba gnyis pa zhig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du 'phros zhal nas thon/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'khor lo sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las kyang de 'dra ba gnyis pa byung ba zhal nas thon pa dag lhan cig tu slob ma rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/

thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'khor lo mum̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa 'od lhag ger gsal ba'i sngags phreng rnams kor kor 'khor ba mos la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad gsung bar zhu/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ sngags brgya rtsa brgyad 'don/ bka' bstan bcos kyi glegs bam gang yang rung ba zhig spyi bor bzhag nas/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang*// nyan dang klog dang len pa dang*// 'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang*// de sems pa dang sgom pa yi// lung mchog dam pa thob gyur cig /ces dang*/ me tog mgor bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po'i skur gsal ba yang 'od zer gyi phung por gyur te khyed rang rnams la thim/ khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi skur gsal ba yang 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa'i ngang nas gang du'ang dmigs su med pa'i 'od gsal ba ji ltar btsal na'ang ci yang ma mthong ba de ltar blta'o// 'di ltar sems dang dmigs pa tha dad par mi mthong ba de'i tshe yang dag par mthong ba ste/ ji skad du/ kun rdzob ji ltar snang ba 'di// rig pas brtag na 'ga' mi rnyed// ma rnyed pa de don dam yin// ye nas gnas pa'i chos nyid do// zhes jo bo chen po'i gsung las mthong ba de lta bu la dran pa dang shes rab kyis ma yengs par/ sems gtad cing mnyam par zhog cig ces dar cig bsgom du gzhug de'i ngang nas don dam pa'i rang bzhin nam mkha' lta bu la lta ba'i shes rab kyi mig dang mi 'bral zhing*/ kun rdzob rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba sgyu ma lta bu la lta ba'i ye shes kyi mig dang bral ba'i sems can rnams la dmigs pa'i snying rje byang chub kyi sems bskul bas/ slar yang sgyu ma lta bu'i lus kyis rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po bsgrub pa la brtson par bya'o// de ltar byas pas khyed rang rnams chos spyod bcu'i sgrub pa rin po che nyams su len pa dang*/

rgyal ba'i bka' bstan bcos mtha' dag la thos bsam sgom gsum bgyid pa la dbang thob pa yin pas bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du lus longs spyod dge rtsa dang bcas pa ltos med du 'bul snyam pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// brjod cing maṇ+ḍal 'bul lo// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan yan lag 'byung*/ dpal ldan gro mo che bdud rtsi grags/ zhang ston chos kyi bla ma/ snar thang sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/

'di gnyis gro mo che'i slob mar 'dug pa bar 'dir zhang ston dgos mi dgos brtag dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchims nam mkha' grags/ zhor ba 'khor lo seng ge la ru ba bsod nams seng ge mkhan chen 'od zer seng ge kun mkhyen mus srad pa dpal ldan seng ge gnyags dbon mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po/ kun mkhyen ban sgar ba 'jam dpal bzang po/ rgyal dbang karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho/ ngo khro rab 'byams pa paṇa chen dbang phyug dpal/ bla ma ma ṇi ba kun dga' rnam rgyal/ si tu rin po che rje btsun chos kyi go cha/ bla ma rin po che karma bzang po/ des bdag dge slong chos kyi rgyal mtshan la'o// de ltar dbang thob nas rgyal bstan rin po che lung rtogs kyi nyams len thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa/ chos spyod bcu nyams su len tshul dge ba'i bshes gnyen snar thang pa chen po mchims nam mkha' grags kyi gsung bzhin brjod pa la/ dang po yi ge 'bri ba ni/ sbyor ba gnas khang chag chag gdab/ phyags dar byas la maṇ+ḍal byugs te/ re khā gnyis skor dang*/ me tog tshom bu dgu bkod la/ de'i steng du khri bzhag de la khri g.yogs bkab/ de'i steng du dpe bzhugs/ mchod pa ci 'byor bsham/ rang stan bde ba la 'dug ste skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ mchod pa phul la gsol ba gdab/ dpe zhal phye ba'i tshe de'i yig 'bru rnams 'od kyi rnam par byon nas bdag gi spyi bor thim pas nyon mongs pa dang sdig sgrib dag par bsam pa lan gsum tsam byas la/ dngos gzhi bris pa'i yi ge sprul pa'i skur byon par bsam ste don yang de ltar yin/ sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis ma brlabs na yi ge 'brir mi btub pa yin no// mjug dge ba bsngo zhing mi dmigs pas rgyas gdab bo gsungs/ gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ rten mchod pa bshams pa sngon du btang ba la maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du glegs bam bzhugs te sbyor rjes sngar bzhin las/ dngos gzhi yig 'bru las 'od byung nas bdag la zhugs pas sdig sgrib dag par bsam zhing mchod pa 'bul/

'di bcu ka la dgos pa'i thun mong gi chos so gsungs/ gsum pa glegs bam sbyin pa ni/ yul dang chos la gdan dang mchod pa bshams la/ yul dang dbul ba po gnyis kas sems bskyed pa dang*/ lhag par dad pa dang*/ sems dwang ba ste chos gsum gsum drug dang ldan par dgos kyis/ gzhan du na gnyis ka mi rung ngo*// tshul ni phyag tu phul ba 'di la chos spyod bcu rdzogs par mdzod la sems can gyi don mdzad par zhu/ zhes brjod do// yul gyis kyang de ltar khas blang*/ sbyor rjes sngar bzhin no gsungs/ bzhi pa nyan pa'i chos ni sbyor rjes 'dra/ dngos gzhi ni 'chad pa po la ston pa'i 'du shes su byas la zhal gyi sgo dang phyag dpe yig 'bru las 'od byung ste/ lha ma srin sde brgyad dang 'khor rnam bzhi la sogs pa 'khor thams cad la phog pas thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las kyi sdig sgrib dag pa la sogs pa lan gsum tsam bya ste/ ma yengs par nyan par bya'o gsungs/ lnga pa klog pa'i chos spyod ni/ sbyor ba bkod pa bshams pa sngon du btang nas/ ston pa'i slob ma sems can gang su dag /'jig rten khams na gnas pa kun nyon cig /deng 'dir ston pas chos kyi char 'bebs kyi// su dag nyan par 'dod pa 'dir shog cig /ces brjod la mdor na brjod bya rjod byed dang bcas pa la yid gtod pa dang*/ gzhan la chos ston pa dang*/ bstan pa klad la bkur ba dang*/ byang chub sems kyi 'du shes te/ 'du shes bzhi bzhag la/ dngos gzhi rkyen myur bul la sogs pa'i skyon spangs te/ thun mtshams skabs bu chung du/ tshig 'phro bzang po la bzhag cing rjes sngar bzhin no gsungs so// drug pa len pa ni sbyor rjes sngar bzhin las/ dngos gzhi dpe las tshig don len pa ste ci tsam nus pa rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i blos phar phyin drug ldan du len pa yin la/ bdun pa 'chad pa ni/ sbyor rjes gzhan 'dra ba la rang gi lce las 'od 'phros te 'khor thams cad la phog pas chos spangs la sogs pa chos rtogs pa'i gegs sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam zhing*/

chos sgrogs pa sngon du btang ste ston par 'du shes pas bshad par bya'o gsungs/ brgyad pa kha ton byed pa klog pa bzhin las yig 'bru las 'od 'phros pa mi dgos gsungs/ dgu pa de sems pa ni tshul bzhin sems pa ste/ dpe las sems na sbyor ba 'bri ba bzhin las dngos gzhi ji tsam nus pa sems la/ dpe med na'ang dpe bzhugs pa las gzhan 'dra'o// bcu pa bsgom pa ni/ spyir chos spyod bcu'i gtso bo thos bsam sgom gsum/ de yang gtso bo sgom pa/ de la gzhung dang don bsgom pa gnyis las/ dang po ni gzhan dag sems drug gis sgom par byed de/ 'dir de dag thun mong ma yin pa kho na bsgom pa ma yin gsungs/ gnyis pa la snying po'i don bsgom pa ni/ bdag med gnyis la sogs pa dbu ma'i don spyir bsgom pa yin la/ mngon par rtogs pa'i don bsgom pa ni mkhyen pa thos bsam gyis gtan la phab nas/ sbyor bzhi'i tshul du nyams su len pa ste/ rnam pa'i khrid du bstan pa ltar nyams len du bya'o// de ltar rjes rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i blos phar phyin drug ldan du chos spyod bcu la 'bad pas mnyam gzhag gi rtogs pa 'phel la/ mnyam gzhag srid zhi mnyam nyid legs par skyes na yang rjes de ltar 'byung ste/ mnyam rjes rgyu 'bras kyi tshul lo gsungs/ de ltar nor bu bstan pa spyi dbang bskur tshul chos spyod rin po che rnam pa bcu'i nyams len dang bcas pa 'di ni/ tā'i si tur grags pa dge slong chos kyi rgyal mtshan dge legs dpal bzang pos rgyal mkhar rtse'i skyed mos tshal du gong ra lo chen pa'i dbon po rig 'dzin mahā lo tsā ba ngag dbang bzang por 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur bgyis pa'i tshe zin bris su bkod pa ste/ de ltar dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro ba rnams// zung 'jug mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen gyi// rnam pa kun ldan rdo rje sems 'grub ste// lung rtogs bstan don mthar thug mngon gyur shog/

//sarba dā maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
